Where AI Risk Creates New Leaders
Registration and exam prep materials are now available for this advanced, practice-driven credential.
REGISTER NOW
AI is reshaping the risk environment. Help lead the way.
Be among the first to embrace AI in IT risk management with the launch of the ISACA Advanced in AI Risk™ (AAIR™) certification. Experienced IT risk professionals are trained to work cross-functionally to recommend a response to AI risk while developing a deep understanding of AI technologies and their challenges.
DO YOU QUALIFY? VIEW GLOBAL DESIGNATIONS QUALIFIED FOR AAIR.
To qualify for AAIR, candidates must hold one of the following designations to enable a focus on the risks and opportunities associated with AI.
ISACA CERTIFICATIONS
CISA® (Certified Information Systems Auditor®)
CISM® (Certified Information Security Manager®)
CRISC® (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control®)
CGEIT® (Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT®)
CDPSE® (Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer®)
GLOBAL DESIGNATIONS
CRMP (Certified Risk Management Professional - RIMS)
CRMP-FED (RIMS-Certified Risk Management Professional-Association for Federal Enterprise Risk Management (AFERM))
CRMA (Certification in Risk Management Assurance - IIA)
CERP (Certified Enterprise Risk Professional - American Bankers Association)
CRCM (Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager - American Bankers Association)
CGRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance Certification - ISC2)
CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional - ISC2)
CIA (Certified Internal Auditor - Institute of Internal Auditors)
ANAN CNA (Association of National Accountants of Nigeria)
GLOBAL DESIGNATIONS, CONTINUED

ACCA (Chartered Certified Accountant - Association of Chartered Certified Accountants)
FCCA (Fellow Chartered Certified Accountant - ACCA)
U.S. CPA (Certified Public Accountant from the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA))
Japanese CPA (Certified Public Accountant from the Japanese Financial Services Agency (FSA) and Japanese Institute of Certified Public Accountants (JICPA))
ACA (Charted Accountant - ICAEW)
FCA (Fellow Chartered Accountant - ICAEW)
CA ANZ (Chartered Accountant - Chartered Accountants Australia-New Zealand)
FCA ANZ (Fellow Chartered Accountant - Chartered Accountants Australia-New Zealand)
CPA HKICPA (Certified Public Accountant - Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants)
FCPA HKICPA (Fellow Certified Public Accountant - Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants)
PMI-RMP (Risk Management Professional - Project Management Institute (PMI))
Don’t yet qualify for AAIR? EXPLORE ISACA CREDENTIALS
For professionals who meet these standards
ACTIVE HOLDERS OF CISA, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, CDPSE AND OTHER RECOGNIZED CERTIFICATIONS
PROVEN EXPERIENCE IN IT RISK OR ADVISORY ROLES
Validate your AI risk expertise with AAIR certification
AAIR is an AI-focused IT risk management credential crafted to enhance the expertise of certified IT risk professionals. It provides the strategic skills to guide management in addressing AI-related risks, safeguarding organizations from potential financial and reputational harm. AAIR’s key practice areas include:
AI Enterprise Governance
AI Life Cycle Risk Management
AI Risk Program Management

Attention Residents of India, Mainland China, and Hong Kong:
The AAIR exam is exclusively available at testing centers. Individuals in these regions cannot use live remote proctoring for this exam.
Register for the exam
AAIR candidates must hold a qualified designation from the list above. Upon registration, AAIR exam candidates have a six-month eligibility period to take their exam. This means that from the date you register, you have six months to take your AAIR exam. It is important to note that the exam registration fee must be paid in full before an exam candidate can schedule and take an exam.
ISACA has a zero-tolerance policy for fraudulent test taking activities. Those involved in fraudulent activities will be subject to score nullification and/or certification revocation. Please see “Terms of Use – 16. Exams.”

Seamless certification journey
ISACA’S AAIR certification exams are computer-based and administered at authorized PSI testing centers globally or as remotely proctored exams. AAIR exam registration is continuous, meaning candidates can register any time, no restrictions. Candidates can schedule a testing appointment as early as 48 hours after payment of exam registration fees.
Log in to MyISACA or create an account to begin
If you are creating an account, please ensure your name matches what appears on your government-issued identification that you will present on the day of your AAIR exam.

Schedule your exam

HOW TO AVOID EXAM PITFALLS
Log in to your ISACA Account >
Click Certification & CPE Management
Click Schedule Your Exam or Visit Exam Website, you will be taken to the PSI dashboard to schedule your exam.
On the PSI dashboard, click Schedule Exam.
ISACA’s Zero-Tolerance Policy
ISACA has a zero-tolerance policy for fraudulent test-taking activities. Those involved in fraudulent activities will be subject to score nullification and/or certification revocation.
VIEW TERMS OF USE FOR EXAMS
Please note, AAIR exam appointments are only available 90 days in advance. If you do not see your exam site or date available for a maximum of 90 days in advance, please check back when it is closer to your desired exam date. If you still do not see your desired exam site or date available, please verify that your AAIR exam eligibility has not expired by logging into your ISACA Account, and clicking the Certification & CPE Management tab.
Rescheduling an exam
You can reschedule your AAIR exam anytime, without penalty, during your eligibility period if done a minimum of 48 hours prior to your scheduled testing appointment. To reschedule an appointment: Log in to your ISACA Account and follow the rescheduling steps in the Scheduling Guide.
